tweets.full_text: YMTC’s move to pursue an A-share listing shortly after CXMT underscores China’s clear ambition to capture a larger share of the NAND market. After surpassing Kioxia in bit shipments in 2Q26 to become the world’s third-largest NAND Flash supplier, the listing would not only provide YMTC with a sustainable funding channel for capacity expansion, but also place the company under the same capital-market spotlight as global players such as Samsung, SK hynix, and Kioxia. YMTC would therefore be subject to the same scrutiny over valuation, financial performance, and supply expectations, marking a shift for China’s memory industry from a policy-supported capacity builder to a more influential competitor in shaping the global market.
